page.layout: One page of text. Running head at top: "IEREMIÆ." with page number "II" at top right. Below it, an italic line above a rule. Then a small-caps acrostic label line "AIM. PF. TSADI.", then the verse block in one column of 24 lines. No notes in the margins, no footnotes.

main_text.head: Vvas rubentes conterunt.
AIM. PF. TSADI.
main_text.p: Hæc me damna iubent acerba flere:
Nam qui me Pater Optimus dolentem
Nulla spes sobolis mihi relicta est:

page.notes: Lines are set as individual verse lines with no stanza breaks visible on the page; each is given as its own paragraph. "emsnus" (line 5) is not clearly legible; the likely reading is uncertain. "venerand a" (line 21) has a gap after "venerand" and the ending is doubtful.
